verdict.rationale: Insomnia's own Git Sync feature connects projects directly to any third-party Git repository, keeps project data in that repository, and offers in-app merge conflict resolution, so the git-versioning half of the story is documented. However, the evidence never states that collections are written to the repo as plain-text, human-readable files; the Insomnia YAML (v5) format appears only as an import format. missing for 10: explicit documentation that Git Sync stores collections as plain-text (e.g. YAML) files in the repo, details on file layout and diffability, independent or hands-on corroboration of the repo-file workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can store collections as plain text files in my repo and version them with git

citations.quote: Git Sync connects Insomnia directly to your Git repository. Your project data stays in your repository. Insomnia does not host or manage it.
Git Sync: for Git storage using any 3rd party Git repository, without going through the cloud.
Insomnia opens a merge view so you can review and resolve conflicts without leaving the app.
Import formats: Insomnia JSON (v4), Insomnia YAML (v5)
